title: Gate closed: cross-wing hand-over (real cloud)
note: REAL run: C1/C2 use the deployed AWS endpoints (real Bedrock); C3 uses a local classical cloud on the real hospital_sim6 pack. Edge = scripts/edge_sim.py (one per wing, kinematic); the east client reports the closed store corner (east_south_hall_corner) via the real edge closure contract, so the east wing can't reach the pickup and the job crosses wings. We measure whether a cross-wing hand-over happened, the wing/leg sequence, who decided it (LLM vs rules), and completion. No map/pack changes to the cloud -- the scenario uses the real map.
